name: Happiness Fix
source:
You wake up in a strange mans home without any memories. You don't even know your name or age anymore... He tells you he's here to take care of you.

But can you truly trust this man?

[From [url=https://headlocker.itch.io/happiness-fix]Itch.io[/url]]

Created for Dark Fiction Jam.
translation:
你在一个陌生男人的家里醒来，没有任何记忆。你甚至不再知道你的名字或年龄……他告诉你他是来照顾你的。

但你真的能相信这个人吗？

[来自[url=https://headlocker.itch.io/happiness-fix]Itch.io[/url]]

为《黑暗小说果酱》创作。
